Each case: expense fields + optional monthlyCost -> expected `variable`.

cases.name: explicit flag true, recurring, with an amount
explicit flag true at zero (the normal κυμαινόμενο row)
explicit flag FALSE at zero — an unfinished expense, NOT variable
explicit flag false with an amount
explicit flag true but NOT recurring — the flag still wins
legacy: recurring at zero -> variable (the pre-flag inference)
legacy: recurring with an amount -> fixed
legacy: NOT recurring at zero -> not variable
legacy: old `recurring` spelling at zero -> variable
legacy: isRecurring wins over the old recurring spelling
legacy: monthlyCost overrides amount when supplied
legacy: monthlyCost zero with a non-zero amount -> variable
null flag is treated as absent (legacy path)
